deterministic_rule: States are copied, never inferred from zero/blank values, and emitted in controlled vocabulary order.

validation_rule: Both record endpoints exist; relationship/level controlled; absence of an edge never becomes INDEPENDENT.
deterministic_rule: Induced edges among component records are sorted by canonical unordered pair then dependency_id.

deterministic_rule: Artifact IDs/hashes are sorted by artifact_id and embedded unchanged in every affected component row.

deterministic_rule: profile_id=SHA256(EnsemblID|profile_version|input_manifest_hash|rules_hash); no randomness, locale, or current time.

validation_rule: All identities, cardinalities, referential links, vocabularies, provenance, dependencies, and hashes pass.
